title: Drag a recipient chip from To to Cc or Bcc
steps: Launch Mail with -UseFakeGmail and open a new message with two synthetic To recipients
Drag one chip down: the hidden Cc and Bcc rows appear; drop it on Bcc
Right-click a chip and choose Move to Cc
expected: The chip moves to Bcc and the Bcc row stays; an address already in the target is not added twice. ⌘Z puts it back in To in one step. The menu (and the VoiceOver actions) move it to Cc.
